source: GGML_TP5_PROFILE-family lines parsed from request log segments (request-{idx}.log)
scope: request segments only (warmup/measured/guard); lines outside request segments are counted separately by the runner against the full server.log

field_boundaries.role: per-stage role NOT_PRINTED; [tp5-mtp-graph] frame_role exists at graph level only
field_boundaries.phase: request phase (warmup/measured/guard) attributed by the collector; [tp5-mtp-graph] execution_phase printed at graph level
field_boundaries.rank: [tp5-linear-definition]/[tp5-dependency-ledger] print rank=; [tp5-relay-stage] prints a per-rank ready_rank_us list
field_boundaries.active_rows: NOT_PRINTED per stage (relay submit takes active_rows but never logs it); [tp5-mtp-graph] ubatch_tokens is graph-level token rows, different granularity
field_boundaries.capacity_rows: NOT_PRINTED per stage; [tp5-mtp-graph] target_capacity is predefined target admission, different semantics
field_boundaries.pipeline: per-stage native pipeline NOT_PRINTED; [tp5-profile] creplay/plan are per-exec aggregate counters; relay direct=1/0 is route selection, not pipeline
field_boundaries.moe_experts: NOT_PRINTED: expert selection is not in profile lines
field_boundaries.bank_epoch: [tp5-relay-stage] epoch printed (bank=epoch&1 derivable); reader-done completion relationship NOT_PRINTED
